t: You're on the Strand, looking at the Adelphi Theatre, a West End theatre in Westminster. This is the fourth theatre to stand on this site, so people have been putting on shows here for a long time. It has been known for comedy and musical theatre, and today it welcomes touring and visiting productions, many of them musicals. The building you see was designed by the architect Ernest Schaufelberg. It has been Grade II listed since the first of December 1987, which means it's protected for its historical value.
